topics.topic: AuditEntry sequence-number reuse after restoring an older backup
questions: After restoring an older backup, may Registry mint sequence numbers that were already minted in the discarded post-backup history, or must it preserve a high-water mark from before the restore?
After restoring an older backup, may Registry reuse sequence numbers that were assigned to post-backup entries before the restore?
After restoring an older backup, may Registry reuse sequence numbers that were written after the backup but lost by the restore, or must a high-water mark outside that backup prevent reuse?

quotes:
its sequence number, minted by Registry: 1 for the instance's first entry,
  then one more than the last ever written; never reused, also after old
  entries are erased (R0-66), so the log's order is the order of the numbers
  even where two entries share an instant (owner, 2026-10-31; codex round-02
  T2).

A store restored from a backup continues the backup's history, whose
  last number it continues from (State 2 A18);
judgement.why: The first passage forbids reuse of any sequence number ever written, while the second resumes numbering from an older backup and therefore reissues numbers written after that backup.

topics.topic: Whether import remains permanently closed after restoring a pre-import backup
questions: After a successful import followed by restoration of a pre-import backup, is another import allowed because MigrationClosure is absent, or refused because an import already succeeded during the instance's physical lifetime?
If the import succeeded and the store is later restored from a backup made before it, is another import permitted or must the prior real-world success still keep the operation closed?
If production successfully imports and is then restored from a pre-import backup, may the import action succeed again, or must the earlier real-world success still keep it closed?

quotes: after the first successful import the operation is closed and refused (R0-79)
The only source is the Registry on the VPS, imported once.

A store
restored from a backup made before the import continues that backup's
history, in which it is absent (State 2 A18).
judgement.why: State 0 permanently closes the one-time import after its first success, while State 1 makes the closure absent after restoring a pre-import backup, allowing the import to occur again.

topics.topic: Treatment of post-backup AuditEntries during restoration
questions: Is backup restoration an additional lifecycle event that removes post-backup AuditEntries, or must those entries be preserved or replayed after restoration?

topics.topic: Whether read-latest accepts published pointers of removed historical types
questions: After a type is removed from the current vocabulary, can the read-latest action read an existing published pointer of that historical type, or must it refuse the type as unknown?
